subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker after the Tool Search subset lands, or should maintainers split the remaining long-session/provider-stream reproduction into a narrower issue?
rationale: Current source proves a narrower Tool Search loss path and related PR ownership, but the original copilot-api/Anthropic-format large-payload/long-session report is broader and needs maintainer scope selection before new automation.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and split after proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Tool Search subset lands, then require a controlled long-session/provider-stream repro before closing or splitting residual work.

options.title: Make Tool Search the canonical path
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96115 as the canonical remaining work and close this only after confirming no non-Tool-Search failure remains.

options.title: Open a fresh narrow repro issue
options.body: Ask maintainers or reporters to file a new current-main live repro issue for copilot-api/Anthropic-format large-payload loss and close this as superseded only after that exists.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and split after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the Tool Search subset lands, then require a controlled long-session/provider-stream repro before closing or splitting residual work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner candidate to local-model Tool Search and provider stream behavior, the two clearest current surfaces in the cluster.
